name: MadAngles

training_provenance.split_method: whole matches (85% train, 15% val), declared before fitting
training_provenance.objective: Class-weighted mode CrossEntropy (weights: [1.5, 0.4, 3.5, 4.0]) + 4.0 * masked steering MSELoss + 0.5 * non-chase steering regularization
training_provenance.checkpoint_selection: Composite score (Mode Acc + 0.5*Jump/Dodge Acc - 10*Steer MAE) on validation matches at Epoch 25
training_provenance.limitations: 1v1 ground play and power flips optimized; wall aerials and advanced air rolls not represented in action contract.

live_acceptance: NOT TESTED after edits; run preflight and GUI match
